working_definition: Combined T4/T5 subtypes a and b (T4a, T4b, T5a, T5b): directionally selective motion-detecting neurons of the optic lobe, with T4 dendrites in the medulla and T5 dendrites in the lobula and axons to the lobula plate.
searches_performed: T4a neuron / T4b neuron / T5a neuron / T5b neuron
T neuron (common parent, checked in local fbbt.obo release 2026-10-01)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Intrinsic columnar neuron of the optic lobe that has its cell body in the posterior part of the optic lobe and a cell body fiber that bifurcates in the second optic chiasma (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It has two branches, each targeting a different neuropil adjacent to the second optic chiasma (lobula, lobula plate and medulla) (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989).

justification: The group spans T4a, T4b, T5a and T5b. T4 neuron (FBbt:00003731) and T5 neuron (FBbt:00003736) are both is_a T neuron (FBbt:00003726), the most specific common ancestor of all four members; no FBbt term groups subtypes a/b across T4 and T5. T neuron includes only T4 and T5 types of the optic lobe in practice. Mature terms for pharate-adult and adult stages.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 1 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a diagonal front-to-back direction (Henning et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Group member; the cluster also contains T4b, T5a and T5b.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 2 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a diagonal back-to-front direction (Henning et al., 2022).
T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 1 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a diagonal front-to-back direction (Henning et al., 2022).
T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 2 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a diagonal back-to-front direction (Henning et al., 2022).

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00003726 'T neuron' (broad match; members T4a, T4b, T5a, T5b).
